About DEEPZ

DEEPZ Tour's and Travels is a professional taxi and travel service based in Tarikere, Chikkamagaluru, Karnataka.

We provide airport transfers, local sightseeing, outstation cabs, one-way trips, family and group tours, weddings & events, corporate travel, Tempo Traveller, mini bus and luxury car services.

About DEEPZ Tour’s and Travels

DEEPZ Tour’s and Travels provides taxi and cab services in Tarikere, Birur, Kadur and Chikkamagaluru, including local taxi, one-way cab and outstation travel services. Popular routes include Bangalore to Chikkamagaluru taxi, Bangalore to Chikmagalur one-way cab, Bangalore to Tarikere taxi, Bangalore to Shimoga and Shivamogga taxi services, and Tarikere to Shimoga and Shivamogga taxi services.

Railway station taxi services are available at Birur Railway Station and Kadur Railway Station, including pickup and drop services to Chikkamagaluru, Tarikere and nearby areas. We also provide Birur to Chikkamagaluru taxi, Kadur to Chikkamagaluru taxi, Chikkamagaluru to Bangalore taxi and Chikkamagaluru to Tarikere taxi services.

Our travel service focuses on comfortable vehicles, friendly drivers, on-time pickup and drop, and practical taxi options for families, groups and outstation travellers.
